title: Evidence manifest entry v1
description: One binding line of `<run>/evidence/manifest.jsonl` exactly as scripts/evidence_manifest.py append_entry writes it. The manifest is append-only JSON Lines; each line is one entry. The request snapshot mirrors what the read side accepts (complete viewport + complete freeze, unknown extra keys tolerated).

ts.description: Write time, ISO 8601 with seconds and an explicit offset.

criterion.description: The declared criterion this artifact proves.

artifact.description: Bare filename under the run's evidence/ directory (no directory parts).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact bytes.

request.description: Capture contract v1 snapshot echoed from the provider, stored verbatim.

capture.description: Optional original provider call, stored verbatim.

observed_state.description: What the provider (or human) actually saw; never a planned label.

error.description: Provider error verbatim; empty on success.

method.description: Method-semantics declaration; key rules live in scripts/method_semantics.py.
